card.text: The Homunculus Nebula is the two-lobed cloud of dust around the star Eta Carinae, about 2,350 parsecs away.

sources.quote: The Homunculus Nebula is a bipolar emission and reflection nebula surrounding the massive star system Eta Carinae, about 7,500 light-years from Earth.

introduction.text: ESA/Hubble's picture of it lies here on the surface its spectra give: two hollow lobes, one tipped toward the Sun and one away.
